title: Generative AI Prompt Artist
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Generative AI Prompt Artist who can create, test, and refine prompts to generate high-quality images, artwork, designs, and creative content using AI tools.

The ideal candidate should have a creative mindset, an interest in artificial intelligence, and the ability to convert ideas into effective AI prompts.

Key Responsibilities

* Create detailed prompts for AI-generated images, artwork, and visual content.
* Work with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL·E, Adobe Firefly, or similar platforms.
* Experiment with different prompt styles, keywords, lighting, colors, composition, and artistic techniques.
* Review AI-generated outputs and improve prompts to achieve the desired results.
* Develop creative concepts based on project requirements.
* Maintain consistency, quality, and originality in AI-generated artwork.
* Collaborate with designers, content creators, and other team members.

Required Skills

* Good creative and visualization skills.
* Basic understanding of generative AI and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with AI image-generation tools is preferred.
* Good attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to learn new AI tools and techniques.
* A portfolio of AI-generated artwork is an advantage.

Qualifications

* Candidates with any educational background may apply if they have the required skills.
* Freshers with a strong interest in AI art are welcome.
* Previous experience in graphic design, digital art, illustration, or prompt engineering is an advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with emerging AI technologies.
* Creative and skill-development opportunities.
* Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
* Remote or flexible working options, depending on business requirements.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Director - SoC Verification
description:
**Date posted** 10/25/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19280****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/25/2026**

**Job Title:**

* Director - SoC Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
* Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
* Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
* Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
* Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
* Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
* Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
* The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
* The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
* Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
* What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
* The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 20+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
* Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
* Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
* Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
* Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

**Who You Are**

* You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
* You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
* You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
* You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
* You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
* You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Infrastructure Support Engineer II
description:
**Business Area:**

IT

**Seniority Level:**

Associate

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is looking for an Infrastructure Support Engineer II to join our Cloud Operations team and help deliver a fast, reliable support service across our global infrastructure estate. This is a hands-on role at the front line of how our engineering and business teams get access to, and get answers about, cloud, on-premises and AI platform services.

You will own day-to-day operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, and you will be one of the first people in the company supporting our internal AI platform. You will also help build the runbooks, automation candidates and knowledge base that make the whole service faster over time. If you like solving problems quickly, writing down what you learned, and then removing the need to solve it again, this is a good fit.

This role reports into Cloud Operations and works closely with our platform engineering, FinOps and identity teams.

### **As an Infrastructure Support Engineer II you will:**

* Own and resolve day-to-day cloud operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including access, identity, account lifecycle and resource queries
* Provide support for our internal AI platform, including access and key management, usage and quota questions, model availability, and onboarding new teams onto the platform
* Support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, handling user access, environment queries and documented break-fix, and escalating operational issues to the engineers who own the stack
* Triage, diagnose and resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues, escalating cleanly with good evidence when an issue needs platform engineering or architecture input
* Execute documented change against our cloud estate safely and accurately, and raise simple infrastructure-as-code changes for review
* Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles so that recurring requests become self-service
* Use AI-assisted tooling to triage, research and draft resolutions faster, while remaining accountable for the accuracy of every answer that reaches a requester
* Maintain the accuracy of our configuration management data and service catalog
* Maintain the inputs to our Infrastructure-As-Code and Github workflow.
* Handle first-line cloud cost and tagging questions, escalating complex optimization work to our FinOps team
* Own the handover between time zones so nothing is dropped between regions
* Identify the requests that should not exist and propose the automation that removes them

### **We're excited about you if you have:**

* Two to four years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure support or IT support, across cloud or on-premises environments
* Working knowledge of AWS, plus Azure or Google Cloud
* Experience working a ticket queue in a service management tool, ideally ServiceNow
* Confidence at the command line and with Linux
* Excellent written communication, because most of this work is written
* A track record of following documented process accurately, and improving it where it falls short
* An interest in identity and access concepts such as SSO, IAM and single sign-on group management

### **Nice to have:**

* Exposure to Github, Terraform or other infrastructure as code
* Exposure to cloud cost management or FinOps practices
* Experience using AI or large language model tooling in a professional setting
* An associate-level cloud certification

**What you can expect from us:**

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**The Role**

Join Kyndryl as an A Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.
  
  
**What you will do**

* Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
* Own shift‑level triage for device migration failures (Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
* Validate pre‑req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce “go/no‑go” criteria.
* Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re‑registration timing, end‑user reset/re‑provision coordination).
* Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; priortize work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
* Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
* Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three‑shift model.
* Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
* Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Kandji/IRU / Jamf escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
* Lead post‑migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
  
  
Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.
  
  
**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Minimum 7 years exp.
* M365 tenant-to-tenant device migration experience, specifically macOS.
* Strong hands-on experience with Jamf/Kandji, macOS provisioning, ADE, PSSO, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Strong PowerShell and macOS scripting/automation skills.
* Experience troubleshooting device enrollment and migration issues.
* Experience with runbook-based 24x7 migration/factory operations, shift handovers, and documentation.
Strong stakeholder communication, troubleshooting, and ownership skills.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience with profile/workstation migration tools such as Jamf, Kandji/IRU, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of Conditional Access and Microsoft device security controls.
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or SC-300.
* Experience with global/remote user migrations.
Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Why Blink:**

* **Industry Leader:** We're at the forefront of the EV charging revolution, building critical infrastructure for a sustainable future

* **Growth Opportunity:** Join a rapidly expanding company in one of the world's fastest-growing industries

We are looking for a motivated **Software Engineer I** to join our **EnergyConnect** team. EnergyConnect is Blink's Energy Management System (EMS) platform, enabling intelligent energy optimisation, EV charging management, site monitoring, and grid integration.

This role is ideal for early-career engineers who enjoy building modern web applications, solving real-world problems, and working across the full software development lifecycle.

You will work with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and maintain production systems used by customers worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

**Build Product Features**

* Develop new EnergyConnect platform features using **TypeScript** and **React**
* Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations
* Design and implement database models, queries, and performance improvements using **PostgreSQL**
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and senior developers to deliver customer-facing functionality

**Quality & Testing**

* Write automated tests for applications and services
* Build and maintain end-to-end test suites using **Playwright**
* Participate in code reviews and follow engineering best practices
* Contribute to continuous integration and deployment workflows

**Learn & Grow**

* Work closely with experienced engineers and mentors
* Gain exposure to scalable cloud-based systems and modern software architecture
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT responsibly to improve productivity and code quality

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 0-2 years of professional software development experience
* Strong hands-on experience with:
* + **TypeScript**
  + **React**
  + **PostgreSQL**
  + **Git**
* Understanding of REST APIs and modern web application architecture
* Familiarity with software testing principles and automated testing
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Passion for learning and building high-quality software

**Preferred Skills:-**

* Experience with:
* + **Node.js**
  + Express.js or similar backend frameworks
  + **Playwright** for end-to-end testing
  + Docker and containerised applications
  + CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, etc.)
* Knowledge of SQL query optimisation and database design
* Experience developing personal, academic, or open-source projects
* Interest in clean energy, sustainability, IoT, or EV technologies

**Technologies You'll Work With**

* TypeScript
* React
* Node.js
* PostgreSQL
* Playwright
* REST APIs
* Git/GitHub
* Docker
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Cloud-based Platforms

**Why Join Blink?**

* Build software powering the global transition to electric mobility
* Work on real-world products used by customers worldwide
* Learn from experienced engineers in a fast-growing industry
* Exposure to modern engineering practices and technologies
* Opportunity to grow your career in the EV and clean energy sector

**Join Blink Charging and help build the software that powers the future of transportation.**

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, configurations, users, and IT assets.
* Use IT service management and ticketing tools to document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Assist with software deployment, patching, updates, endpoint configuration, backups, and routine maintenance activities.
* Support cybersecurity practices such as endpoint protection, access control, phishing awareness, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and incident reporting.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, change management practices, security controls, and data protection requirements.
* Assist with system administration tasks across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, virtual machines, or other environments, as applicable to the assigned team.
* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

  
Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

Nice to have Skills :

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to IT service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with networking tools, command-line utilities, remote support tools, monitoring platforms, or diagnostic utilities.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, batch scripting, or other automation and scripting technologies.
* Exposure to endpoint management, mobile device management, patch management, software deployment, or configuration management tools.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and practices, including endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, identity and access management, security monitoring, and incident response.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with virtualization, containers, backup systems, storage, servers, or infrastructure monitoring.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base articles, process guides, diagrams, or user training materials.
* Exposure to AI assistants, automation tools, prompt engineering, or AI-enabled IT support and knowledge management workflows.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

**THE MIX MATTERS**

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

**Work Location: Malaysia**

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

Candidates with 5–10 years of experience who have progressed from hands-on AI/ML

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

apply.

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

title: Team Lead, Support Engineering
description:
As a **Team Lead, Support Engineering** at FloQast, you will lead a specialized team dedicated to delivering exceptional technical support for FloQast customers across the Accounting Workflow Automation Platform. Like all roles on the FloQast Support team, this is a hands-on leadership position. You will report to a Manager or Director of Support Engineering and run your team with a high degree of autonomy, balancing your time between hands-on work and people management, ensuring you remain a primary resource for your team while mentoring Technical Support Engineers to unblock customers effectively.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead a specialized team of Technical Support Engineers dedicated to unblocking customers through troubleshooting and technical administrative and configuration work across the FloQast Accounting Workflow Automation Platform.
* Own talent strategy for the team, including hiring, onboarding, training, 1:1 meetings, annual reviews, performance coaching, and career development.
* Oversee the team's work and collaborate asynchronously with US colleagues and leadership.
* Build and optimize processes such as routing work between teams, and drive improvements through AI, tooling, documentation, and data insights.
* Maintain strong proficiency in the FloQast platform, staying current with features and limitations, product updates, future roadmap, and best practices to effectively support both customers and the team.
* Remain hands-on with the team's work, including configuration requests, focusing your bandwidth where it can best help customers and the team.
* Leverage internal admin tools (Admin Portal) to execute CRUD operations in the database.
* Track and report on key Support metrics and queue health, including request volume and urgency, ensuring accurate prioritization, timely responses, and effective resolutions.

Our engineers work on translating complex backend systems into clean, engaging, and responsive experiences across platforms. From enhancing usability to ensuring resilience at scale, the team plays a critical role in shaping how consumers engage with technology.

* Define product technology strategy and vision
* Manage and prioritize technology roadmap and initiatives
* Own engineering key results and performance metrics

* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams with a focus on career development and innovation
* Foster an environment where engineers are encouraged to experiment and contribute new technical ideas
* Provide constructive feedback through code reviews to enhance technical value and quality

**Performance Measurement and Optimization**

* Monitor delivery and quality metrics at the product level to identify trends and drive technical improvements

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technology roles, with increasing responsibilities in engineering management
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant, cloud-based, high-transaction systems
* Experience in full-stack enterprise Java development, including React Web and Native
* Expertise in Scaled Agile (e.g., SAFe), Scrum, Lean quality, and test automation methodologies
* Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java), cloud technologies, and tools such as Jira
* Strategic technical thinker capable of developing and communicating a product-aligned technology roadmap

* Effective collaboration skills to support teams in problem-solving and decision-making
* Experience working with RTEs, STEs, and stakeholders to align and execute strategic themes
* Strong knowledge of continuous delivery and agile at scale practices
* Ability to serve as an Agile coach and advisor, promoting a self-directed and accountable team culture
* Balances technical oversight with empowering teams to innovate and own their solutions
* Drive automation.

description:

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18913****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/20/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade designing analog circuits that have to move data at speeds most engineers never touch, and you know that the difference between a SERDES that works in simulation and one that works in silicon is a hundred small decisions about layout, process variation, and timing handoff. You are the kind of engineer who reads a SerDes standard and immediately starts sketching architectures that push beyond what the spec requires because you see where the bottleneck will be two years from now.

You do not wait for someone to tell you the PLL is the problem. You run the jitter budget, trace it back to the oscillator, and propose three solutions before the next design review. Taped-out circuits in FinFET nodes where a few femtofarads of parasitic capacitance can kill your bandwidth have taught you to work with layout engineers who understand that your redline is not optional.

Presenting simulation data to a customer review panel and explaining why your adaptive equalizer architecture will handle their worst-case channel without adding another milliwatt is something you do comfortably. Mentoring matters to you, not because it looks good on a review, but because you remember the senior engineer who taught you how to read an eye diagram and you want to be that person for someone else.

At Synopsys, you will work on Multi-Gbps SERDES IP that goes into chips that power data centers, automotive networks, and AI accelerators. The problems are hard, the process nodes are cutting-edge, and what you design will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review high-speed SerDes standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL) and translate them into transceiver architectures and detailed sub-block specifications for Multi-Gbps NRZ and PAM4 designs
* Architect and design analog/mixed-signal circuits including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and ADC/DAC blocks for advanced FinFET and gate-all-around process nodes
* Collaborate with digital design teams on analog/digital co-design, calibration loops, adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance
* Work directly with layout engineers to guide physical implementation, minimize parasitics, manage device stress and process variation, and ensure robust post-silicon performance
* Present simulation results, design trade-offs, and architectural decisions in internal reviews, customer meetings, and industry panel discussions
* Document design features, simulation methodologies, test plans, and characterization results, and support post-silicon bring-up and debug with electrical analysis and design iteration proposals
* Analyze customer silicon data and field performance to identify improvement opportunities and drive post-silicon design updates for next-generation IP releases

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Define the architectural direction for Synopsys SERDES IP, influencing product roadmaps and enabling next-generation connectivity standards across automotive, data center, and AI markets
* Deliver power, performance, and area improvements that directly affect the competitiveness of Synopsys IP in advanced process nodes and high-speed communication applications
* Solve post-silicon challenges that unblock customer tape-outs and ensure successful deployment of Synopsys IP in high-volume production chips
* Mentor analog designers across the team, raising the technical bar for circuit design, simulation methodology, and design-for-reliability practices
* Strengthen Synopsys leadership in Multi-Gbps SERDES by contributing to industry standards bodies, customer engagements, and technical publications
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by streamlining design and verification flows and reducing silicon respins through robust pre-silicon validation
* Shape the future of high-speed analog design at Synopsys by driving innovation in adaptive equalization, low-power PLLs, and signal integrity for next-generation process technologies

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech/MS with 8+ years or BTech/BS with 10+ years of hands-on analog IC design experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven track record of CMOS tape-outs in FinFET technologies with demonstrable experience in Multi-Gbps high-speed designs using NRZ and PAM4 modulation
* Deep expertise in SERDES sub-circuit design including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and data converters
* Strong understanding of analog/digital co-design, calibration and adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff between analog and digital domains
* Proficiency with schematic entry, physical layout collaboration, design verification tools, and SPICE simulators (Spectre, HSPICE, or similar)
* Experience with scripting languages such as TCL, PERL, or MATLAB for post-processing simulation data and automating design tasks
* Solid grounding in system-level budgeting for jitter, amplitude, and noise, and familiarity with signal integrity challenges including packaging parasitics, crosstalk, and channel loss. Experience with ESD protection, custom digital design, and design-for-reliability considerations (electromigration, IR drop, aging, self-heating) is a plus. Prior experience with high-speed interleaved SAR ADCs is a strong plus.

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, look at a jitter waterfall plot, and pinpoint the architectural bottleneck in under five minutes without needing a slide deck
* You push back when a specification does not make sense or when a layout decision will compromise performance, and you do it with data and a proposed alternative
* You are the engineer others come to when a circuit is not behaving and simulation does not match silicon, because you know how to debug across domains and find the real root cause
* You write clear, thorough documentation because you know that six months from now, someone else will need to understand your design choices and you want them to succeed
* You stay current with emerging process technologies, circuit techniques, and industry standards because you know that what works in 7nm will not necessarily work in 3nm
* You value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and you take the time to explain a complex trade-off to a junior engineer or a non-technical stakeholder without losing the nuance

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As the Manager of the Extensibility Platform team at Docusign, you will lead a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team focused on developing and scaling the Extensibility Platform, as well as building new Extension Types and first-party applications. The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging

title: Senior Engineer - MDM
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs.  
  
The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve.  
  
The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.
* Troubleshoot mobile device enrollment, connectivity, policy compliance and application delivery issues using NinjaOne and remote support tools.
* Manage incidents, requests and changes through ServiceNow while documenting troubleshooting activities and customer communications.
* Take ownership of assigned tickets and drive issues through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.
* Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using NinjaOne software management capabilities.
* Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.
* Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.
* Participate in an on call rotation to provide emergency support coverage when required.
* Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate with NinjaOne support or third party vendors as necessary.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge base articles.
* Recommend process improvements and identify operational risks or areas of concern to management.
* Continue developing technical expertise across additional MDM and endpoint management technologies as business needs evolve.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work and/or military experience.
* 2+ years of experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC), Managed Services or IT Operations environment.
* 2+ years of hands on experience administering or supporting a Mobile Device Management platform in a production environment.
* Hands on experience with NinjaOne MDM including device enrollment, policy configuration, software deployment and compliance monitoring.
* Experience managing iOS, Android and Windows mobile devices including enrollment via Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise or Windows Autopilot.
* Knowledge of MDM concepts including device configuration profiles, compliance policies, conditional access and remote device actions such as lock, wipe and retire.
* Understanding of mobile security concepts including device encryption, certificate based authentication, passcode enforcement and data loss prevention policies.
* Familiarity with identity and access management concepts as they relate to MDM including Azure Active Directory or Entra ID integration and single sign on.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose device enrollment, policy and connectivity issues across multiple platforms.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiences.
* Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast paced operations environment.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in SLA driven support environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL based incident, problem and change management processes.
* Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms.
* Experience with additional MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf or VMware Workspace ONE.
* Familiarity with NinjaOne RMM capabilities including scripting, automation and alerting as they complement MDM operations.
* Experience with PowerShell or scripting tools for automating device management tasks and reporting.
* Relevant certifications such as NinjaOne certifications, CompTIA Mobile App Security or equivalent vendor credentials.

#### **Core Competencies**

* Accountability and ownership
* Adaptability and flexibility
* Analytical thinking and problem solving
* Attention to detail
* Customer focus
* Dependability and integrity
* Initiative and self direction
* Team collaboration
* Stress tolerance and professionalism under pressure
* Continuous improvement mindset

title: Principal Firmware Engineer (Security)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Axiado**

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Principal Firmware Engineer to manage a talented team while remaining a highly hands-on technical contributor. You will lead the design, development, and optimization of highly secure embedded systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Secure Boot, attestation schemes such as SPDM, secure provisioning, cryptographic firmware signing, and key/certificate revocation mechanisms, alongside strong knowledge of RTOS, Linux kernels, device drivers, and bus protocols. This "player-coach" role requires exceptional problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex hardware-security interactions, as well as the leadership abilities to guide, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management & Hands-On Contribution: Lead, manage, and grow a team of firmware engineers while remaining a core individual contributor. Dedicate a significant portion of your time to writing code, conducting code reviews, and resolving low-level technical challenges.
* Security Architecture & Boot Flow: Architect, develop, and optimize embedded software solutions with a primary focus on end-to-end platform security, including Secure Boot, hardware Root of Trust (RoT), and verified boot pipelines.
* Protocols & Provisioning: Implement and manage attestation schemes such as SPDM for device authentication and remote measurement, alongside secure factory and field secure provisioning workflows.
* Firmware Signing & Lifecycle Management: Design and maintain cryptographic firmware signing infrastructure, secure update pipelines, and robust revocation mechanisms (such as anti-rollback counters, key revocation lists, and certificate revocation).
* Debugging & Security Analysis: Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software and cryptographic failure modes using advanced debugging tools (JTAG, GDB, logic analyzers).
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with security experts, hardware engineers, and system architects to define roadmaps and deliver scalable embedded security solutions, while contributing to open-source security standards or embedded projects.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Experience: 20+ years of experience in embedded software development, featuring a strong foundational background in C/C++.

* Team Leadership: Proven track record of managing and leading engineering teams while maintaining an active, hands-on role in software development and system architecture.
* Security Expertise:
  + Proven experience with Secure Boot, Root of Trust (RoT), and cryptographic security principles (symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, hashing, digital signatures).
  + Hands-on implementation experience with attestation schemes such as SPDM for hardware authentication and platform measurement.
  + In-depth knowledge of secure provisioning methodologies, HSM (Hardware Security Module) integration, and secure key storage.
  + Robust understanding of firmware signing workflows and lifecycle revocation architectures (e.g., CRLs, embedded validation, fuse-based key revocation).
* System Software & Hardware: Extensive experience with RTOS, Linux kernel, device drivers, and hardware bring-up using Board Support Packages (BSPs).
* Protocols & Interfaces: Strong grasp of peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB) and bus protocols (PCIe, Ethernet), with PCIe root port and SR-IOV knowledge being a strong plus.
* Toolchains & Build Systems: Familiarity with Linux build frameworks such as Yocto and Buildroot, alongside low-level debugging via JTAG and GDB.
* Preferred Domains: Experience with Baseboard Management Controllers (BMC) and hardware security accelerators.

 **Additional Information**

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

description:

**Job Description:**

**Senior Engineer Software/Firmware Development**

We are seeking a strong senior engineer with broad embedded systems experience to contribute to next-generation automotive connectivity and display solutions. This role spans embedded firmware, low-level driver development, developer tooling, and system integration for automotive-oriented products.

The position involves development across multiple software components, including embedded firmware running on ARM Cortex-class platforms, host-side configuration and tooling applications, and software integration across heterogeneous compute environments. The role includes work related to embedded security, standards-based automotive connectivity technologies, and interoperability-focused software development.

You will work closely with globally distributed engineering teams and technical leadership to implement high-quality software that meets functional, reliability, safety, and cybersecurity expectations for automotive deployments.

This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy broad technical ownership, hands-on product development, solving system-level problems, and collaborating across disciplines in a fast-moving environment while maintaining high standards for software quality and engineering rigor.

Strong communication skills, ownership, and collaborative execution are essential for success in this role, including regular coordination with remote technical leadership across time zones.

**Responsibilities:**

* Implement embedded firmware and software features for automotive connectivity and display products.
* Develop ROM-based firmware and low-level embedded software for ARM Cortex-class platforms.
* Develop and maintain software components including drivers, platform interfaces, configuration tools, and developer workflow integrations.
* Contribute to configuration-generation and initialization tooling used to support product bring-up and deployment workflows.

* Support traceability between requirements, implementation, testing, and delivered software artifacts.
* Develop and debug embedded software using JTAG, GDB, emulation environments, and hardware evaluation platforms.
* Perform software bring-up, validation, issue investigation, and root-cause analysis using lab hardware and evaluation kits.
* Support software integration and evaluation on Linux-based automotive compute platforms.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, architecture reviews, and technical planning activities.
* Deliver reviewed, tested, maintainable, and well-documented software contributions integrated into shared repositories and CI/CD workflows.
* Create and maintain technical documentation including specifications, design notes, integration guides, user documentation, release notes, and engineering handoff materials.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed global teams across multiple time zones.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8-10+ years of professional experience in embedded software and firmware development.

**Core Technical Skills:**

* Strong programming skills in C and C++.
* Working knowledge of Python for scripting, tooling, automation, or test development.
* Strong understanding of embedded systems fundamentals including memory architecture, interrupts, peripherals, boot flows, hardware/software interaction, and low-level debugging.
* Experience developing embedded firmware for ARM Cortex-class embedded processors.
* Familiarity with secure software development practices and cryptographic concepts.
* Experience developing low-level drivers, platform software, or board-support software.
* Experience debugging embedded systems using JTAG, GDB, emulation platforms, and lab hardware.

* Experience with hardware/software integration workflows using evaluation boards and emulation environments.

**Development Practices:**

* Ability to interpret and implement software requirements from technical specifications and industry standards.
* Strong understanding of software quality practices including code reviews, static analysis, unit testing, integration testing, and maintainable software design.

**Professional Skills:**

* Comfortable collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams across shared time-zone overlap windows.

**About Us**  
We are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the OpenBMC and platform management software that runs on AMD Adaptive SoC platforms. You will contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, delivering management, telemetry, and serviceability for servers, AI accelerators, and next-generation data center and embedded systems.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and the OpenBMC open-source community, you will take new platforms from first power-on through to a supportable, upstreamable solution, and build the reference designs that AMD product teams and external customers adopt for their own platforms.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about platform management software and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in OpenBMC and embedded Linux, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through platform bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable working across the full stack, from an I2C device to a Redfish endpoint, and have the communication skills to collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **OpenBMC Software Stack:** Contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, including the phosphor services, D-Bus interfaces, and application layer that deliver manageability on AMD platforms.
* **Hardware Description and Telemetry:** Develop Entity Manager configurations, sensor and FRU definitions, and the thermal, power, and fan control behaviour for each platform.
* **Management Interfaces:** Deliver the out-of-band management surface, including Redfish and bmcweb, IPMI, remote console and KVM, and MCTP and PLDM transports.
* **Firmware Update and Security:** Build the update and recovery path, including image signing, A/B and golden-image recovery, root-of-trust integration, secure boot, and attestation.
* **Platform and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new platform and board bring-up from first power-on, driving issues to root cause with hardware, firmware, and silicon architecture teams.
* **Yocto Integration:** Maintain the Yocto layers and recipes that build and configure the BMC software stack across platforms and releases.
* **Upstream and Technical Leadership:** Contribute to the OpenBMC project, keep AMD trees in step with upstream, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack, including components such as Entity Manager, D-Bus services, bmcweb and Redfish, and IPMI.
* Working knowledge of **BMC products and the platform management domain** — server, storage, or AI accelerator board bring-up, out-of-band management, remote console and KVM, and interfaces such as I2C, eSPI, PECI, APML, MCTP, and PLDM.
* Strong **embedded Linux** background, including the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint: device trees, kernel configuration, driver enablement, and sysfs and hwmon.
* Working experience with the **Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded** — layers, recipes, and bbappends.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning operating systems, drivers, firmware, and hardware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Platform security and root of trust: secure and measured boot, firmware signing, and attestation.
* Experience developing **reference designs, demonstration platforms, or proof-of-concept solutions** adopted by product teams or external customers.
* **DC-SCM, DC-MHS, OCP**, or other modular hardware and open compute standards.
* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, **RISC-V**, and inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP**.
* Contributions to OpenBMC, Yocto Project, or Linux open-source projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer

Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

description:
Data Architect

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**
