Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  
Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

The Network Infrastructure Engineer Senior Associate works in a technically collaborative environment supporting the firm's enterprise and Microsoft Azure network operations. The role supports wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, next-generation firewalls, remote access, SD-WAN, Azure connectivity, application delivery, and voice services. The Senior Associate contributes to incident resolution, approved changes, network upgrades, cloud connectivity, and modernization initiatives while following

**Responsibilities:**

* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot wired LAN, wireless (Wi-Fi), Internet, WAN, and cloud network services across office and remote environments.

* Support Azure Virtual WAN operations, including virtual hubs, hub-to-VNet connections, VPN sites, VPN and ExpressRoute gateway health, hub route tables, route association and propagation, and secure hub connectivity.
* Use Azure Network Watcher and platform monitoring tools to investigate connectivity, routing, security-rule, latency, and packet-flow issues and to document findings.
* Support Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall, load-balancing, Application Gateway, and secure application delivery services within established architecture and security standards.
* Monitor Internet transport, BGP routing, circuit health, and bandwidth utilization; coordinate with telecommunications providers and vendors during incidents and service restoration.
* Plan and implement approved network changes, complete pre- and post-change validation, document results, and follow change-control, rollback, and security procedures.
* Contribute to office openings, network refreshes, cloud migrations, upgrades, and modernization projects in partnership with senior engineers and cross-functional teams.
* Work with security, infrastructure, application, and service desk teams to resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and escalate complex issues.
* Maintain IP address management records, Azure network inventory, subnets, VLANs, wireless SSIDs, diagrams, configuration baselines, runbooks, and support procedures.
* Participate in after-hours maintenance and the on-call rotation as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Two to five years of relevant experience in enterprise network engineering, network operations, infrastructure support, or a closely related role.
* Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, and common network troubleshooting methods.
* Hands-on experience supporting wired and wireless LAN technologies, enterprise firewalls, VPNs, and network security controls.
* Experience monitoring or troubleshooting SD-WAN, WAN circuits, Internet connectivity, and remote access services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, VNet peering, VPN Gateway, and hybrid connectivity.
* Familiarity with Azure Virtual WAN, virtual hubs, site-to-site and point-to-site VPN connectivity, ExpressRoute, route propagation, Azure Firewall, and integration.
* Experience using network monitoring and diagnostic tools; exposure to Azure Network Watcher, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or comparable platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with WAFs, load balancers, secure web application delivery, SIP trunking, VoIP, or Microsoft Teams telephony is preferred.
* Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, change control, vendor coordination, network deployments, or infrastructure refreshes.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize work and collaborate across technical teams and time zones.
* CCNA, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or comparable foundational certification is preferred;
* Exposure to PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform, and Python for automation and interacting with API endpoints is an advantage.

title: Sr Staff High-Speed Interface Verification Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19281****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
* Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3.1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
* Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
* Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
* Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
* Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
* Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
* Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
* Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
* Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
* Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
* Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
* Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
* Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
* Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
* Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3.1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
* Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
* Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
* Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
* You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
* You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
* You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
* You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
* You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide.

  
  

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Threat Research Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

An overview of this role

As an Threat Research Engineer at GitLab, you'll research emerging security threats and turn your findings into protection for GitLab customers. You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.  
This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.  
  
What you'll do

* Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
* Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
* Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
* Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
* Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
* Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
* Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you'll bring

* Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.
* Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
* Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
* Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.
* Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
* The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
* Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
* Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.
* You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team  
We're the Threat Research group. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning, and publish our findings on the Security Labs blog.  
Our work includes research on the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent.

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
description:
**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.

The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Cloud Network Management Testing**
------------------------------------

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

**Test Planning and Execution**
-------------------------------

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

**API Cloud and Data Validation**
---------------------------------

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.
* Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

**Networking and Troubleshooting**
----------------------------------

* Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.
* Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.
* Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.
* Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

**Test Automation**
-------------------

* Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.
* Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.
* Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.
* Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.
* Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

**Defect Management and Team Collaboration**

title: Principal / Lead Python Architect
description:
**Job Title:** Principal Python Software Architect / Staff Engineer

**Department:** Software Engineering & Platform Operations

**Experience Level:** 12 – 18 Years

**Location:** [City, Country / Hybrid / Remote]

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

We are seeking a visionary **Principal / Lead Python Software Architect** with 12 to 18 years of hands-on technical and leadership experience to lead the architectural evolution, performance optimization, and technical strategy of our enterprise platform.

In this role, you will design resilient, scalable distributed systems, modernize legacy backend pipelines, establish enterprise-wide Python engineering standards, and integrate cutting-edge asynchronous processing, data processing, or AI/ML workloads into our core infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise Architecture & System Design

* **Distributed Systems Design:** Architect, scale, and maintain fault-tolerant, low-latency, and high-concurrency microservices architectures using modern **Python (3.11/3.12+)**.
* **Framework & Ecosystem Mastery:** Architect complex web services, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous message-driven systems using **FastAPI, Django, Flask, Asyncio, Celery, and RabbitMQ/Kafka**.
* **Modernization & Refactoring:** Drive migration and refactoring strategies from legacy backend monoliths into scalable, cloud-native microservices or event-driven frameworks.
* **AI/Data Pipeline Integration:** Oversee the architectural integration of machine learning models, vector databases, semantically indexed search engines, or LLM workflows into production systems.

2. Engineering Governance, Security & Performance

* **Performance Engineering:** Troubleshoot deep memory leaks, event loop bottlenecks, and execute CPU/IO profiling to achieve ultra-low latency and efficient memory management.
* **Database Architecture:** Design, optimize, and manage high-volume relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, including complex query optimization and sharding/partitioning strategies.
* **Security & Compliance:** Enforce enterprise-grade security standards (OWASP, OAuth2/OIDC, data encryption at rest/in transit, zero-trust backend architecture).
* **Code Excellence & CI/CD:** Establish automated testing standards (PyTest), static analysis tools (Mypy, Ruff, Black), and containerized CI/CD deployment automation (Docker, Kubernetes).

3. Leadership, Mentorship & Technical Strategy

* **Technical Roadmap:** Collaborate closely with the CTO, Product Managers, and Executive Leadership to translate long-term business strategy into robust tech roadmaps.
* **Engineering Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and elevate Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, and cross-functional engineering teams, fostering a strong culture of innovation and engineering rigor.
* **Vendor & Tooling Evaluation:** Evaluate and select third-party cloud tools, frameworks, and infrastructure services to maximize operational efficiency and cost ROI.

Technical Qualifications & Requirements

* **Total Experience:** 12 to 18 years of progressive software engineering experience, with **8+ years dedicated to Python backend development** at massive scale.
* **Core Python Expertise:** Deep internal mastery of Python (Memory Management, GIL internals, Asyncio, Multiprocessing, Metaclasses, Generators, and Type Hinting).
* **Backend Stack:** Proven expertise in **FastAPI / Django / Flask**, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, gRPC, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL.
* **Concurrency & Message Queues:** Hands-on experience with asynchronous task processing via Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or Redis Pub/Sub.
* **Databases & Caching:** Mastery of PostgreSQL / MySQL query optimization, schema design, and caching layers (Redis, Memcached).
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with cloud environments (**AWS / GCP / Azure**), Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless architectures, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CloudFormation).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Soft Skills & Leadership Profile

* **Strategic Business Acumen:** Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs with business ROI, cost, and time-to-market top of mind.
* **Executive Communication:** Skilled at presenting complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical engineers and non-technical C-suite executives.
* **Crisis Management:** Decisive leadership during major production outages, complex security incidents, or critical release cycles.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer (AI Solutions)
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

#### **So, what's the role all about?**

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Every tool we launch needs a great front door, and that is the Support Helpdesk.

As Support Helpdesk in the SPARK team, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues using the AI tools SPARK builds: answering questions, triaging issues, fixing what you can, and escalating what you cannot, with clear evidence. You are an advanced software engineer at heart, so you can go beyond scripts and FAQs: read logs, test an API call, spot a configuration or prompt problem, and explain it in simple terms.

You will be the primary helpdesk owner, supported by a backup or rotating colleague for cover, and you will partner closely with the AI Architects & Builders and the Change Management & Evangelist. What you learn from users will shape what SPARK builds and improves next.

#### **How will you make an impact?**

You will own the user support experience for SPARK solutions, keeping colleagues productive and feeding what you learn back into the tools.

#### **Support Our Users**

* Be the first point of contact for user questions, access requests, and issues, through the team's support channels
* Triage, prioritise, and track every request through to resolution in the ticketing system, with clear and timely updates to users
* Troubleshoot technical issues by reviewing logs, testing API calls, checking configurations and prompts, reproducing problems, and fixing what is within your reachEscalate to the AI Architects & Builders with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, so engineers can act fast

#### **Build Knowledge**

* Create and maintain FAQs, how-to guides, and a searchable knowledge base for every SPARK solution
* Document known issues, workarounds, and runbooks, and keep them current as solutions change
* Help onboard new users and groups, working with the Change Management & Evangelist on guides and training materials

#### **Spot Patterns and Improve**

* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring issues, usability gaps, and training needs, and report them to the Change Management & Evangelist and the AI Architects & Builders
* Track support metrics such as volume, response and resolution times, user satisfaction, and top issues, and share regular summaries
* Capture user feedback and feature requests for the product backlog
* Create real time dashboard for requestor to have visibility into progress

#### **Automate and Cover**

* Use scripts and AI tools to automate repetitive support tasks such as triage, routing, FAQ answers, and reporting
* Coordinate with your backup or rotating support colleague to maintain coverage during absences and busy periods
* Help monitor usage and platform health, and raise alerts on anything that looks wrong

#### **Have you got what it takes?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 4-8 years of experience as a software engineer, or in L2/L3 application or technical support for software products
* Hands-on technical skills: scripting or programming (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), SQL, REST APIs, tools such as Postman, and reading application logs
* Experience with ticketing and service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, and the patience to guide non-technical users clearly
* Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and concise answers and documentation
* Everyday use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and an understanding of how AI answers can go wrong
* An ownership mindset: you stay with an issue until it is resolved or handed over cleanly
* Fluency in English
* Ability to work support hours that cover the regions the team serves (working pattern to be confirmed)

#### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience supporting internal AI tools, chatbots, or agent platforms
* Experience building automations or lightweight bots for support
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, and with basic CI/CD
* Experience with knowledge base tools and writing technical documentation
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS support
* Experience supporting users across multiple time zones

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! title: Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

**Job Description:**

**You will work with**

You will lead a high-energy, top-performing team of engineers and product managers, working alongside technology and business leaders to shape the vision and drive the execution of progressive platform initiatives that make a real impact.

  
  

**Let me tell you about the role**

The Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer provides engineering leadership across bp's digital landscape, connecting squads with bp's platforms and engineering capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions aligned to business strategy. They lead end-to-end technical delivery, ensure engineering integrity at scale, and actively manage delivery and technical risk while guiding teams through complex build challenges.

Operating as a hands-on technical leader with strong customer and stakeholder influence, they balance long-term engineering excellence with near-term delivery outcomes, empowering squads to make sound technical decisions and fostering a unified, pragmatic, and sustainable engineering culture across bp.

This role will play a key leadership position in delivering modern B2B customer portal and commerce capabilities, working closely with customer engagement platforms, product teams, architecture teams, SAP teams, and engineering squads to maximise reuse of shared platform capabilities and accelerate delivery through modern composable architecture principles.

  
  

**What you will deliver**

  
  

**Technology**

Leads a team of enterprise engineers to design, develop, and deliver high-quality platforms and services. Acts as a hands-on technical authority on bp's platforms, languages, and frameworks, including Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns. Drives squad goals, prioritises initiatives, and delivers in a product-led, empowered environment. Guides modernisation of legacy estates to unlock future capabilities.

  
  

**Delivery & Transformation**

Owns end-to-end delivery of complex B2B commerce and customer portal transformation programmes, from discovery through build, migration, cutover, and hypercare. Manages delivery risk, sequencing, and dependencies across squads, vendors, and SI partners. Ensures legacy-to-modern transitions are planned for coexistence, data migration, and minimal business disruption.

Drives adoption of MACH and composable architecture principles, ensuring alignment with strategic customer engagement platforms through reuse of shared capabilities, APIs, services, and design patterns.

  
  

**Data**

Engineers data-intensive solutions and integration flows across enterprise systems. Builds secure, governed, and interoperable data pipelines with strong quality, lineage, and observability. Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.

  
  

**Commercial Awareness**

Applies engineering insight to cost and value priorities, including cloud spend and TCO. Evaluates tools and platforms for fit, resilience, and lock-in risk to inform build-vs-buy decisions.

  
  

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

Embeds secure-by-design practices and supports audit, licensing, and compliance obligations as part of routine delivery.

  
  

**Collaboration & Influence**

Acts as a technical expert, providing guidance and support to the squad and wider engineering community. Communicates clearly with team members, partners, and customers. Represents engineering in governance and design forums to resolve technical trade-offs.

Leads and governs delivery partners, system integrators, and product vendors, ensuring architectural and engineering standards are upheld across the extended delivery ecosystem.

Works closely with Product, UX, Architecture, SAP, Integration, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align with strategic platform roadmaps and maximise reuse of common capabilities and technical assets.

  
  

**Building Teams**

Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.

  
  

**Growing People**

Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.

  
  

**Change Leadership**

Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.

  
  

**What you will need to be successful**

  
  

**Technical Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Strong technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, JavaScript, relational databases, microservices, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) patterns, API orchestration, API gateways, and modern distributed system design.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering modern web applications using React, reusable component architectures, responsive design, GraphQL, and headless front-end architectures.
* Experience delivering cloud-native applications on Azure and/or AWS using containers, Kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps pipelines.
* Experience implementing enterprise security solutions including OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Azure AD, SSO, and role-based access control.
* Experience working with Git-based source control, modern software delivery practices, and engineering lifecycle management.
* Experience leading delivery through vendor and SI partner ecosystems, holding partners accountable for engineering quality, timelines, architecture compliance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience designing and delivering global, multi-country, multi-currency, and multi-language B2B commerce and customer portal solutions.
* Experience within the Energy, Oil & Gas, or other complex enterprise industries is an advantage.
  

  

**Essential Skills**

* Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems.
* Strong experience delivering B2B customer portals and commerce solutions using MACH (Microservices, API-First, Cloud-Native, Headless) and composable architecture principles.
* Deep technical expertise in **Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL**, API-led integration, and event-driven architectures within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms with **SAP ERP/S/4HANA** and other business-critical systems using modern integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native delivery on Azure and/or AWS, including infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, operational readiness, and lifecycle ownership.
* Proven experience in reliability engineering, incident management, disaster recovery, application performance monitoring, and operational excellence for business-critical platforms.
* Experience delivering solutions spanning custom-built software, configured platforms, and third-party integrations at enterprise scale.
* Experience establishing engineering standards, architecture governance, reusable platform capabilities, and engineering best practices across multiple squads.
* Strong ability to resolve technical trade-offs across squads, platforms, vendors, and stakeholders while balancing delivery, architecture, and business priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, UX, Architecture, Platform Engineering, SAP, and business teams to deliver customerfocused solutions.
  

  

**Desirable Skills**

title: Staff Engineer, Design Verification - High-Speed Interface IP
description:

**Staff Engineer, Design Verification - High-Speed Interface IP**
=================================================================

**We Are**
----------

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**
-----------

You are an experienced Digital Verification engineer who enjoys solving complex verification challenges in high-speed digital designs. You bring a strong understanding of ASIC design and verification methodologies and have hands-on experience verifying designs involving high-speed interface protocols.

You are comfortable working with complex RTL designs, developing verification environments, debugging failures, and driving verification to closure. Experience with **PCI/PCIe or USB** interfaces is particularly valuable, with **USB experience highly preferred** for this position.

With approximately **5–6 years of relevant experience**, you are ready to take ownership of verification activities while collaborating closely with design engineers and other technical teams.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Develop and execute verification strategies for complex ASIC and digital IP designs.
* Build, enhance, and maintain verification environments for high-speed digital interfaces.
* Develop test plans, test cases, stimulus, checkers, and coverage models to achieve verification objectives.
* Verify functionality of designs involving high-speed protocols, particularly **PCI/PCIe and USB**.
* Debug simulation failures and collaborate with RTL design engineers to identify and resolve functional issues.
* Analyze functional and code coverage and drive verification toward closure.
* Participate in design and verification reviews and contribute to improving verification quality and efficiency.
* Take ownership of assigned verification areas from planning through final verification closure.

**The Impact You Will Have**
----------------------------

* Help ensure the functional quality and robustness of complex ASIC and digital IP designs.
* Contribute to successful verification and delivery of high-speed interface technologies.
* Identify design issues earlier in the development lifecycle through thorough verification and debugging.
* Improve overall verification coverage and quality through systematic test development and coverage analysis.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to help deliver reliable, high-quality semiconductor IP.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* Approximately **5–6 years of relevant experience in ASIC/Digital Verification**.
* Strong knowledge of ASIC and digital design verification concepts.
* Hands-on experience verifying **high-speed protocols/interfaces**.
* Experience with **PCI/PCIe and/or USB**, with USB experience highly preferred.
* Experience developing and maintaining verification environments for complex digital designs.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills for identifying RTL and verification-environment issues.
* Understanding of test planning, functional verification, coverage analysis, and verification closure.
* Ability to work effectively with design and verification teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Position is based in **NCR**.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You approach complex verification problems methodically and take ownership through resolution.
* You are comfortable digging into RTL, waveforms, logs, and verification results to understand failures.
* You communicate technical issues clearly and collaborate effectively with design and verification engineers.
* You pay close attention to quality and coverage rather than simply getting tests to pass.
* You can work independently while contributing effectively within a broader engineering team.
* You are curious, technically driven, and comfortable learning new interfaces and verification challenges.

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
------------------------------

You will be part of a digital engineering team working on ASIC and high-speed interface technologies. The role involves close collaboration with design and verification engineers to develop robust verification environments, identify functional issues, and drive designs toward verification closure.

**Rewards and Benefits**
------------------------

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

PyxTech is a B2B SaaS and AI technology company specializing in enterprise software, AI-powered solutions, digital engineering, and technology consulting. We help organizations modernize enterprise architecture, automate workflows, and unlock business value through intelligent data and AI solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Semantic Data Architect / Ontologist** with strong expertise in enterprise ontology development, RDF-based semantic modeling, and knowledge graph architecture.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies, building semantic data models, connecting fragmented enterprise data sources, and implementing W3C semantic web standards to support enterprise search, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic knowledge models.
* Build RDF-based semantic data structures using RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems into connected knowledge graphs.
* Develop and manage controlled vocabularies, metadata models, and taxonomy lifecycle processes.
* Implement SHACL-based data validation and constraints, along with SKOS for knowledge organization.
* Deploy and manage knowledge graphs using Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Work with ontology and taxonomy management platforms such as PoolParty and TopBraid EDG.
* Optimize semantic models for enterprise search, analytics, metadata extraction, and AI applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Support cloud-based deployments using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of overall IT/data experience.
* **Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience specifically in RDF-based semantic ontology development and modeling.**
* Strong expertise in enterprise ontology design, taxonomy development, and semantic metadata management.
* Expert knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Practical experience with SHACL and SKOS.
* Production experience with at least one graph database: Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ontology/taxonomy management platform, such as PoolParty, TopBraid EDG, or GraphDB (Ontotext).
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and overlap with US business hours.
* Maximum notice period of 30 days.

Preferred Skills

* NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and semantic metadata extraction.
* Experience with spaCy or similar NLP tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise search, knowledge discovery, and AI-driven applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Library Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Interview Process

* HR Screening and Initial Evaluation
* Client Technical Assessment / Deep Dive
* Client Final / Behavioral Interview

How to Apply

If you have strong hands-on experience in RDF-based ontology engineering, semantic data architecture, and enterprise knowledge graphs, we would love to hear from you.

**Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your ontology projects, RDF experience, graph database expertise, and notice period.**

**Important:** This role requires substantial practical ontology engineering experience, not just general data architecture or basic knowledge of graph databases.

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Within our division, we develop and deliver interface subsystems that power industry-leading SoCs. You are an enthusiastic engineer who thrives at the intersection of various interface IPs. Your analytical mindset and collaborative spirit drive you to solve complex technical challenges that shape the future of connectivity. * Coding and debugging test cases, including the creation of complex checkers and assertions using System Verilog/UVM.
* Extracting and reviewing functional coverage (FC) and code coverage metrics to ensure quality metric goals are met.
* Managing regressions and contributing to the continuous improvement of verification strategies and test environments.
* Debugging and resolving simulation failures, ensuring root-cause analysis and timely solutions.
* Working closely with RTL designers and architects to ensure functional correctness.

### **The Impact You Will Have:**

* Drive quality that powers AI, automotive, cloud, and mobile applications at massive scale.
* Advance the state-of-the-art in AI assisted verification methodologies, influencing future verification flows and processes.
* Contribute to the early detection and resolution of critical design issues, reducing time-to-market and silicon re-spins.
* Collaborate with a global team of experienced verification engineers, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth.
* Bolster Synopsys' leadership in chip design by ensuring our IP verification methodologies set industry standards.

### **What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in electronics/electrical engineering or related field, with 8+ years’ experience in ASIC/FPGA Verification.
* Ability to debug and define robust verification strategies; experience mentoring is a plus for senior candidates.
* Demonstrated experience in technically leading a team, record of successful collaboration and stakeholder management.
* Proven expertise in developing System Verilog/UVM based test environments for complex ASIC designs.
* Advanced skills in developing and implementing rigorous test plans, checkers, assertions, and coding complex tests.
* Strong proficiency in extracting and analyzing verification metrics such as functional coverage and code coverage.
* Experience with interface protocols and IP design/verification processes; knowledge of DDR/HBM/PCIe/UCIe/Ethernet/UALink is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience in owning end-to-end verification deliverables for IPs, including planning, execution, DV metrics closure, and review/signoff.

* Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.

**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a governed, metadata-driven data integration and staging platform centered on SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and enterprise databases/data lakes — spanning source ingestion (SAP ERP/S/4HANA, non-SAP systems), a source-faithful central staging repository, long-term archival, and controlled distribution to multiple downstream systems.

We're looking for a DataOps Engineer who treats ETL pipeline design, data flows, and access-control logic as configuration, not one-off code — someone who builds and maintains systems where metadata tables and control frameworks drive what gets executed (jobs, interfaces, delta loads, transformations, and security masking), rather than hand-crafting individual one-off BODS jobs for every new dataset or consumer.

You'll work across ingestion (landing central staging archive), retention/partitioning strategy, and the routing/distribution rules engine that determines how data is extracted, transformed, filtered, or masked across multiple major downstream systems.

What You'll Do

* Build and operate robust batch and incremental change data capture (CDC) ingestion pipelines using SAP Data Services (BODS) from SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, SLT, ODP/Extractors) and non-SAP sources into central staging repositories/databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, or Cloud Storage).
* Design and maintain metadata-driven ETL generation & execution frameworks — where dataset onboarding (new source table, delta logic, schema mapping, validation rules) is driven by configuration tables and reusable BODS templates/scripts rather than creating bespoke data flows from scratch.
* Implement and maintain partition-based retention, database archiving, and extraction routines for historical data and rolling window retention policies (e.g., current + N prior years).
* Build and maintain a dataset routing-rules engine: a governed metadata table (splittable, target\_systems[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) that programmatically directs and transforms BODS distribution jobs and target views per downstream system.
* Own BODS repository architecture & governance: manage local/central repositories, Data Services Management Console (DSMC), user access security, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), and execution auditing/lineage.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: streamline BODS export/import/transport automation, repository synchronization, and job scheduling via Enterprise Scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory).
* Monitor pipeline health, job execution logs, CDC checkpoint integrity, schema drift, and data SLAs; establish automated alerting and self-healing for job failures and data-freshness breaches.
* Collaborate with upstream SAP functional/basis teams to define data contracts (e.g., Delta queue/ODP parameters, timestamps, extraction load impact) and downstream teams to translate their access/filter requirements into routing rules.
* Document pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, retention policies, and routing logic for auditability and seamless developer onboarding.

**️** Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP BODS

* Hands-on experience with SAP Data Services (BODS 4.x) designing complex Batch Jobs, Real-time Services, Workflows, Data Flows, and custom Scripts/Functions.
* Strong expertise in extracting data from SAP environments (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, ODP extractors, SLT, IDocs, RFC/BAPIs) as well as non-SAP flat files, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and relational database internals (e.g., SAP HANA, SQL Server, Oracle): query optimization, indexing, table partitioning, push-down SQL execution, and incremental CDC logic.
* Solid experience with BODS Central Repository management, object check-in/out workflows, version control, and multi-user development standards.

Metadata-Driven Engineering (Critical)

* Demonstrable background designing or maintaining metadata/config-driven ETL frameworks — e.g., control/registry tables driving dynamic SQL generation, parameterized BODS global variables, or generic reusable data flow templates.
* Strong understanding of keeping generated ETL processes and target tables in sync with a source-of-truth ruleset, including schema versioning and change auditability.
* Experience implementing automated audit logging, error handling, row-count reconciliations, and execution metrics captured directly via BODS scripts and database tables.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* ETL Orchestration & Scheduling: Experience managing automated job schedules and dependency management via BODS Management Console, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, Airflow, or Autosys.
* CI/CD & Version Control: Experience applying software engineering discipline to BODS (e.g., Git integration/documentation, automated repository migrations, deployment scripts).
* Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate file transfers, API interactions, and operational tasks around the BODS platform.
* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience setting up alerting, performance bottleneck troubleshooting (memory/buffer tuning in BODS), and data validation frameworks.

Governance & Collaboration

* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance: access control models, data lineage, retention/compliance-driven deletion, and data masking/obfuscation techniques for sensitive data (PII).
* Experience serving multiple downstream consumers with varying analytical and operational requirements by delivering filtered and governed interfaces.
* Clear written communication habits; ability to articulate complex ETL architectures and governance rules to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Information Steward (data quality profiling, rule building, metadata management).
* Hands-on experience integrating SAP BODS with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3).
* Exposure to SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) or SAP Data Intelligence / Datasphere.
* Experience in large-scale multi-tenant enterprise environments supporting cross-functional business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

Config-Driven Onboarding: Standard source table onboarding (source

* landing/staging) is reduced to a configuration-driven process using reusable BODS templates, drastically reducing manual job creation.
* Automated Retention & Purging: Automated partition/date-based archiving and retention mechanisms are operational across staging repositories.
* Operational Routing Rules: A central metadata-driven routing table governs downstream extraction/distribution, dynamically applying required column masking and row filters.
* Resilient DataOps: Automated alerting, execution telemetry, and standard environment promotion workflows are established and fully documented.

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18976****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of physical design, where a misplaced power ring or a routing bottleneck can turn a promising memory macro into a timing nightmare. Layout is not just drawing rectangles to you, it is solving a puzzle where every micron counts and every decision ripples through verification, performance, and yield. You know that the difference between a memory compiler that ships and one that gets stuck in debug is usually a floor plan decision made two weeks earlier, and you are the kind of engineer who sees that coming.

You are comfortable moving between Calibre or ICV verification runs, XARA power analysis, and sitting with circuit designers to understand why a bitcell is behaving the way it is. When a DRC violation shows up at tape-out minus two days, you do not panic, you methodically trace it back, fix it, and document it so it does not happen again. You have strong opinions about power grid design and you can back them up with IR drop numbers.

At Synopsys, you will work on memory IP that goes into chips powering everything from AI accelerators to automotive systems. The layouts you own will be used by customers worldwide, and the quality bar is exactly as high as you would expect.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and own full custom layouts for embedded memory blocks, including SRAM, register files, and ROM compilers across advanced process nodes
* Develop floor plans, place memory cells and periphery blocks, route power grids and signal interconnects to meet area, performance, and power targets
* Run IR drop and electromigration analysis using tools like XARA, back-annotate layout parasitics, and iterate with circuit teams to close timing and power
* Execute physical verification using DRC and LVS tools such as ICV or Calibre, debug violations, and drive layouts to clean signoff
* Collaborate with memory compiler architects and circuit designers to translate specifications into manufacturable, verified layout deliverables
* Script layout automation flows using TCL, Perl, or C-shell to improve productivity and ensure consistency across memory variants
* Support formal release cycles, including documentation, design rule checks, and handoff to product engineering and customers

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable Synopsys memory IP to meet aggressive PPA targets that directly affect customer chip performance and power efficiency
* Reduce layout development cycle time through automation and reusable design practices, accelerating time to market for new memory products
* Ensure memory macros pass physical verification and reliability checks on the first pass, minimizing costly respins and customer escalations
* Contribute to the quality and competitiveness of Synopsys memory compiler offerings used in high-volume production across automotive, mobile, and AI markets
* Influence layout methodology and best practices that shape how the team approaches next-generation process nodes

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

  

### **Benefits**

  

***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
